Set the exponent correctly:
\[
k-\frac{9-k}{2}=\frac{3k-9}{2}=0 \implies k=3.
\]
The constant term coefficient is
\[
\binom{9}{3}2^{6}(-1)^3 = 84\cdot 64\cdot(-1)=-5376.
\]
The sum of all coefficients is the value at \(x=1\):
\[
\left(\frac{2}{1}-1\right)^9=1.
\]
Excluding the constant term:
\[
1-(-5376)=5377.
\]
\[
\boxed{5377}
\]
